preconditions.description: The length of the string s must be between 1 and 200,000.
The number of queries q must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l_i <= r_i <= len(s) for l_i, r_i in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must have valid indices l_i and r_i within the bounds of the string s.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum(z_function(s[l_i-1:r_i]) for l_i, r_i in queries))
postconditions.description: The output must be the sum of the Ж-function values for each query substring.
